lines.en: My friend lives with me and never cleans the kitchen. I am tired of it.
lines.pt: Meu amigo mora comigo e nunca limpa a cozinha. Estou cansado disso.

lines.en: If I were you, I would talk to him this evening.
lines.pt: Se eu fosse você, conversaria com ele hoje à noite.

lines.en: But I don’t want an argument. He is a good friend.
lines.pt: Mas não quero uma briga. Ele é um bom amigo.

lines.en: If you say nothing, it will never change. If I were you, I’d be honest and kind.
lines.pt: Se você não disser nada, nunca vai mudar. Se eu fosse você, seria honesto e gentil.

lines.en: What would you say? I never know the right words.
lines.pt: O que você diria? Eu nunca sei as palavras certas.

lines.en: I’d say: “Can we make a plan for the dishes?” That is easy to accept.
lines.pt: Eu diria: “Podemos fazer um plano para a louça?” Isso é fácil de aceitar.

lines.en: If I had more time, I would clean everything myself.
lines.pt: Se eu tivesse mais tempo, limparia tudo eu mesmo.

lines.en: No, don’t do that. If I were you, I wouldn’t clean his mess.
lines.pt: Não, não faça isso. Se eu fosse você, eu não limparia a bagunça dele.

lines.en: You are right. If he listened, we would both be happier.
lines.pt: Você tem razão. Se ele ouvisse, nós dois ficaríamos mais felizes.

lines.en: And if he didn’t listen, I would ask the owner of the house for help.
lines.pt: E se ele não ouvisse, eu pediria ajuda ao dono da casa.

lines.en: Thanks, Zainab. If I were you, I would be a teacher!
lines.pt: Obrigado, Zainab. Se eu fosse você, seria professor!

facts.big: If I were you, I would…
facts.label: If I were you
facts.sub: Conselho: If I were you, I would + verbo. Segundo condicional: If + passado, would + verbo. Pergunta: What would you…?

facts.label: Se eu fosse você
facts.sub: Use If I were you para dar conselho: If I were you, I would talk to him. Em inglês correto, use were com I, he e she nesta expressão. Depois da vírgula, use would + verbo simples.

facts.label: If + passado
facts.sub: No segundo condicional, a parte do if usa o passado: If I had more time. O resultado usa would: I would clean everything. Descreve algo imaginário ou improvável agora.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “If I were you” is used to give advice.
We say “If I was you” in careful English.
items.why: We say If I were you.

items.s: After if, we use the past simple.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “If I were you” is used to give advice. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “If I was you” in careful English. → Falso (We say If I were you.)
After if, we use the past simple. → Verdadeiro (Yes: If I had time.)

pages.title: Advice from a good friend · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a warm evening in Austin. Dean and Dan sit on a bench near the river. Dean needs advice about a problem at home. The friend who lives with him leaves every chore for him. Dan listens and thinks before he speaks. Good advice is often simple and kind.

“My friend lives with me and never cleans the kitchen. I am tired of it.” says Dean. “If I were you, I would talk to him this evening.” says Dan. “But I don’t want an argument. He is a good friend.” says Dean.
